app.name: Audit Report Anchoring
app.tagline: Anchor audit-report PDFs on a public testnet, and let anyone check a copy in their browser.
app.prototypeNotice: Prototype. Testnet anchors are not legal evidence.

kitchenSink.title: UI kit
kitchenSink.intro: Every component this repo copies from Inflect, rendered in this app's theme.
kitchenSink.clientHint: The UIC for a Bulgarian company.
kitchenSink.opinionDescription: Confirm the text exactly as it appears in the report.
kitchenSink.tooltipContent: A 32-byte SHA-256 value. Only commitments go on chain.
kitchenSink.emptyDescription: Upload an audit report to anchor its first version.
kitchenSink.errorDescription: The two RPC endpoints disagree, so no verdict is shown.
kitchenSink.modalBody: A second person approves every anchor before it is broadcast.
kitchenSink.confirmBody: Revocation is permanent and visible to every verifier.
kitchenSink.sheetBody: Each version names its parent, so every copy resolves to the latest.

login.title: Sign in
login.failed: The email or password is wrong, or there have been too many attempts. Try again in a few minutes.

empty.title: No engagements yet
empty.description: A preparer creates an engagement, then uploads the first version of its report.

engagement.newIntro: An engagement is one report and all its versions. Its details form the report's pseudonymous id; only that id, never these details, ever goes on chain.
engagement.registrationNumberHint: The UIC for a Bulgarian company. Spaces are ignored.
engagement.engagementRefHint: Your firm's own reference for this engagement.

upload.title: Upload a version
upload.fileHint: At most 25 MB and 500 pages. The file is stored encrypted.
upload.reason: Why is the report being reissued?
upload.draftPending: A draft version is waiting for its opinion to be confirmed. Confirm or discard it before uploading another.

errors.UNAUTHENTICATED: Your session has ended. Sign in again.
errors.CROSS_ORIGIN: This request did not come from this site.
errors.INVALID_INPUT: Some details are missing or not valid. Check the form.
errors.TOO_LARGE: The file is larger than 25 MB.
errors.UNSUPPORTED_MEDIA_TYPE: Only PDF files can be uploaded.
errors.DOC_ALREADY_UPLOADED: This exact file has already been uploaded.
errors.ENGAGEMENT_EXISTS: An engagement with these details already exists.
errors.DRAFT_PENDING: A draft version is already waiting for confirmation.
errors.VERSION_CONFLICT: Someone uploaded a version at the same time. Reload and try again.
errors.NOT_DRAFT: This version is no longer a draft.
errors.INTERNAL: Something went wrong. Nothing was changed.

refusals.NOT_A_PDF: This file is not a PDF.
refusals.TRUNCATED: This PDF is cut short: it does not end the way a complete PDF does. Upload the complete file.
refusals.TOO_LARGE: This PDF is larger than 25 MB.
refusals.TOO_MANY_PAGES: This PDF has more than 500 pages.
refusals.TOO_MUCH_TEXT: This PDF has more text than an audit report could hold.
refusals.ENCRYPTED: This PDF needs a password to open. Upload a copy that opens without one.
refusals.UNPARSEABLE: This PDF could not be read.
refusals.TIMEOUT: Reading this PDF took longer than 20 seconds, so it was stopped.
refusals.RESOURCE_LIMIT: Reading this PDF needed more memory than allowed, so it was stopped.
refusals.PARSER_CRASHED: The PDF reader stopped unexpectedly on this file.

viewer.failed: The PDF could not be shown.

notFound.NO_TEXT_LAYER: This PDF has no text layer (it may be a scan), so the opinion could not be read from it.
notFound.MULTIPLE_OPINION_HEADINGS: More than one opinion heading was found, for example in a bilingual report.
notFound.NO_BASIS_HEADING: The opinion heading was found, but not the "Basis for…" heading after it.
notFound.HEADING_TYPE_MISMATCH: The opinion heading and the "Basis for…" heading name different opinion types.
notFound.OPINION_TOO_LONG: The text found is too long to be only the opinion.

confirm.foundHint: Found under the heading "{heading}" on pages {from}–{to}. Check it against the report.
confirm.typeItIn: Type or paste the opinion paragraph from the report.
confirm.textDescription: Exactly as it appears in the report. Spacing and line breaks do not matter.
confirm.reportDateHint: The date the report was signed.
confirm.dialogBody: The type and text become part of this version's commitment, which will be anchored. They cannot be changed afterwards; a correction is a new version.
confirm.discardBody: The uploaded file and everything extracted from it are deleted. Nothing has been anchored.

version.anchorOnlySigned: This PDF carries a digital signature, so it will be anchored as it is and never rewritten.
version.anchorOnlyProtected: This PDF is protected against editing, so it will be anchored as it is and never rewritten.

flags.xfa: This PDF contains an XFA form.

version.awaitingPreparer: Waiting for a preparer to confirm the opinion.
version.commitmentsHint: Only these values will go on chain. Nothing has been anchored yet.
